main_body: A palm-like tree: a spiky dark-green frond canopy on a tall, thin brown trunk with a small flared base.
top_band: Canopy: a small light-green patch at rows 2-6 (L~142) in the middle of dark green fronds. The rest of the canopy is dark green, with no clear separate top band. The trunk has no top surface.
evidence: This is an organic tree. The canopy is a rosette of fronds seen from above and in front, with a lighter crown highlight on top, and the trunk is a vertical column below it. Both parts read acceptably for an organic plant. The dark frond mass under the lit crown acts as the shaded front. There is no flat-band or rim-only cap problem. The 3/4 contract is loosely met for an organic plant.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 13 distinct colours and a median of 8 colours per tile, against about 108 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. The canopy has only about 4 green steps and little leaf-clump texture. The trunk is a plain two-tone stripe pattern that repeats every 4 rows, with a mechanical look. The dark edge pixels are 16% neutral, so the outline is mixed. Next to the lush, richly clumped reference trees it looks thinner, flatter and more sticker-like.
